purpose: Main demonstration: realistic requirements that the economy-first strategy is not expected to meet on the first attempt.
request: Design a small autonomous delivery robot with a 2 kg payload, at least 2 hours runtime, maximum speed of 1.5 m/s, total mass below 8 kg, and budget below 1500 SAR. Use commercially available components.

purpose: Different requirements: light indoor payload, longer runtime, low speed, tighter budget.
request: Design an indoor robot cart that carries 1 kg for at least 4 hours at up to 0.8 m/s on flat office floors. It must weigh under 5 kg including the load and cost less than 1200 SAR. It needs obstacle detection.

purpose: Reliability: requirements no database part combination can meet. HERMES must stop gracefully with a best candidate and a human-review flag.
request: Design a small autonomous delivery robot with a 2 kg payload, at least 12 hours runtime, maximum speed of 2.5 m/s, total mass below 3 kg, and budget below 600 SAR.
